releases.title: MiniMax two-pass diagnostics, Qwen downloads, and complete project saves

sections.title: Added
items: MiniMax H3 two-pass progress now reports the exact Pass 1 and Pass 2 sampler steps from the built hidden workflow.
MiniMax H3 two-pass progress now reports the exact LoRAs and strengths attached to each pass in the built hidden workflow.
LLM model downloads now have separate Gemma and Qwen subtabs, with model-specific notes and folder guidance.
Qwen3.8-27B GGUF downloads now open the repository root so users can choose their preferred quantization and model files.

sections.title: Fixed
items: Fixed MiniMax two-pass settings being lost when switching scenes or starting a render; the active Pass 1 and Pass 2 controls are flushed directly into the request.
Fixed Quick Save and autosave omitting Gemma model, Qwen model, and Qwen mmproj selections from the saved project session.
Fixed Quick Save and autosave not flushing live MiniMax builder and scene settings before serialization.

sections.title: Compatibility Notes
items: Restart ComfyUI and hard-refresh the browser after updating so the revised Builder JavaScript and saved-session behavior are loaded.
Qwen3.8 requires a selected GGUF model (including all shards for that quantization) and its matching vision mmproj. Rename the projector to qwen-mmproj-BF16.gguf when using it alongside Gemma.

releases.title: Qwen Local LLM support, synchronized Builder models, and project recovery fixes

sections.title: Added
items: Added Qwen Local as a dedicated LLM Runner choice with its own GGUF model, optional vision mmproj, external GGUF file picker, context limit, output-token limit, and GPU-layer settings.
Added Qwen GGUF discovery across every registered models/LLM location and Qwen subfolder so installed Qwen models appear in the LLM Runner dropdown instead of being limited to one folder.
Added Builder support for sending text and image-reference prompt requests through the selected local Qwen model.

sections.title: Changed
items: The model selected in LLM Runner now synchronizes with every matching Builder model field. Qwen is placed in both the non-vision text and vision model fields because it supports both uses, and its selected mmproj is synchronized with the vision fields.
Gemma Local model selections now synchronize with the Builder model fields in the same way, while external LM Studio, API, and own-server runners keep their server-managed model settings.
Builder model labels now say LLM model instead of incorrectly identifying every selected model as Gemma.
Thinking mode is explicitly disabled for both Qwen Local and Gemma Local Builder requests so prompt generation returns the requested answer without an automatic thinking section.

Builder and Storyboard windows, progress dialogs, action buttons, hints, and runner-aware errors now display the selected Gemma Local, Qwen Local, LM Studio, LLM API, or Custom Server name instead of hardcoding Gemma.

sections.title: Fixed
items: Fixed Qwen Local remaining visually stuck on Gemma after it was selected and saved in LLM Runner.
Fixed installed Qwen models not appearing in the Qwen model dropdown when they were stored in another configured LLM model location.
Fixed loaded projects showing blank or missing thumbnails by creating missing thumbnail directories before recovering preview frames from the saved media.
Fixed project loading failing with Cannot read properties of null (reading 'image_history') when a saved scene or preview entry was empty.
Fixed switching the Audio Builder to MiniMax H3 failing on the same null image_history state by restoring a valid active scene before synchronizing the MiniMax panel.
Fixed saved Qwen, Gemma, and mmproj selections being replaced by stale Builder dropdown values after loading a project or refreshing the available model lists.

Fixed Story Arc generation failing when Qwen echoed an instruction heading instead of immediately returning the exact lyric-section headings. Clearly instructional preambles are ignored when a valid arc follows, and invalid structures receive one automatic strict-format retry before an error is shown.
Fixed model-emitted <think>, Thought, Thinking, Analysis, and Reasoning preambles leaking into Builder and Storyboard output even when local thinking mode is disabled.
Story Arc format failures now include a collapsed diagnostics panel with the runner, expected headings, raw model response, cleaned response, and a copy-output button.

sections.title: Compatibility Notes
items: Restart ComfyUI and hard-refresh the browser after updating so the revised Python routes, local LLM support, and Builder JavaScript are loaded.
Place Qwen GGUF and compatible mmproj files in a configured ComfyUI LLM model folder, or select an external GGUF file directly in LLM Runner.
Older projects remain compatible. When possible, missing scene thumbnails are rebuilt automatically from their saved image or video media when the project loads.

releases.title: LTX 2.5 workflows, MiniMax H3 three-pass rendering, and Storyboard improvements

sections.title: Added
items: Added LTX 2.5 as the default LTX engine version, with LTX 2.3 retained as a legacy option for older GGUF and dual-CLIP workflows.

Added LTX 2.5 Text to Video and Reference to Video support using the existing custom/project-audio workflow, including the LTX 2.5 video VAE, audio VAE, latent spatial upscaler, and required Licon MSR LoRA selections.
Added an experimental MiniMax H3 Ref to Video 3 Pass mode. Stage 1 establishes the scene, Stage 2 refines it, and Stage 3 produces the final clip used by timeline stitching.
Added independent three-pass controls for megapixels, steps, denoise, sampler, scheduler, seed, and TE-Speed on every pass, plus a dedicated LightX LoRA and strength control.
Added automatic Stage 1 and Stage 2 backup collection for three-pass renders so intermediate results remain available for review while Stage 3 becomes the selected scene video.

Added LTX-aware Storyboard defaults, cut-frequency planning, starting-shot guidance, camera-flow instructions, and ordinary-language chronological cut descriptions sized to each scene's exact duration.

sections.title: Changed
items: LTX 2.5 model defaults now select its matching video VAE, audio VAE, latent spatial upscaler, and MSR assets automatically, while switching back to LTX 2.3 restores the legacy defaults.

Storyboard prompt generation now follows the selected project engine: MiniMax retains timestamped CUT TO formatting, while LTX receives natural chronological editing language without MiniMax-only prompt structure.
Storyboard scene defaults, camera motion, character motion, performance direction, visual effects, and cut plans now apply consistently to both MiniMax and LTX projects.
MiniMax two-pass and three-pass progress messages now identify the active stage sequence and explain which intermediate clips are retained and which stage will be used for final stitching.
MiniMax three-pass settings now save immediately, restore with the project session, and expose only controls that affect the selected rendering mode.
LTX 2.5 Text to Video now dynamically swaps the diffusion and CLIP nodes in the proven custom-audio T2V graph instead of forcing the native-audio graph.
All supported LTX Builder modes preserve supplied project/global or custom scene audio and its SRT timing.

sections.title: Fixed
items: Fixed MiniMax three-pass Stage 3 audio output and final-video selection so the completed Stage 3 clip is used for playback and stitching.
Fixed three-pass TE-Speed patching so each pass uses an isolated model branch and one pass cannot leak patched model state into another.
Fixed Stage 1 and Stage 2 backup discovery, registration, project copying, session persistence, and restoration during and after three-pass rendering.
Fixed LTX 2.5 Reference to Video settings so the correct model assets, pass strengths, dimensions, and generation options reach the hidden workflow.
Fixed invalid legacy .pth upscaler selections being reused by LTX 2.5; affected projects now migrate to the LTX 2.5 latent spatial upscaler.
Fixed LTX prompt generation to return one clean generation-ready prompt without internal headings, metadata labels, duplicated cut instructions, or MiniMax-only formatting.
Fixed Storyboard saves that could appear to fail after the project had already saved successfully because unrelated panel settings were re-normalized afterward.
Fixed side-panel Gemma generation so scenes without a usable image reference fall back to the text-only prompt path instead of failing the request.
Fixed LTX storyboard scene-beat handoff, singer/lip-sync guidance, and exact-duration cut planning so regenerated prompts preserve the intended performance and editing structure.
Fixed LTX 2.5 Text to Video custom-audio routing without using the legacy GGUF path.

sections.title: Compatibility Notes
items: Restart ComfyUI and hard-refresh the browser after updating so the new Python routes, workflow templates, Builder JavaScript, and Storyboard JavaScript are loaded.
The included workflow templates do not download models. Install the matching LTX 2.5 and MiniMax H3 model files and select them in Builder Settings before rendering.
MiniMax H3 two-pass and three-pass modes currently require Input Audio. Built-in MiniMax audio continues to use the existing one-pass workflow.
LTX 2.5 Text to Video uses custom/project audio; the native-audio T2V template is not used by the Video Builder.
LTX 2.5 is now the default for new LTX projects. Existing projects retain their saved engine version and settings whenever those values are present.
Three-pass Stage 1 and Stage 2 videos are review backups; Stage 3 is the final scene video used by Render All and timeline stitching.

releases.title: MiniMax H3 two-pass Reference-to-Video rendering

sections.title: New
items: Added a MiniMax H3 Ref to Video 2 Pass mode in the Video Builder for external/custom audio projects.
The two-pass workflow saves separate Stage 1 and Stage 2 outputs. Stage 2 is automatically collected for timeline stitching, while Stage 1 is retained as a review backup on the scene.

sections.title: Improved
items: Exposed MiniMax H3 reference-image sizing in Advanced Settings with Match generation size and Max identity fidelity options.
MiniMax H3 Advanced Settings now open by default and continue to expose sampler, scheduler, denoise, EasyCache, SageAttention, fp16, and reference-conditioning controls.

sections.title: Compatibility Notes
items: Restart ComfyUI and hard-refresh the browser after updating so the revised Python nodes, workflow template, and Builder JavaScript are loaded.
The current two-pass Builder mode uses Input Audio. Built-in MiniMax audio remains on the existing one-pass path until a separate built-in-audio two-pass adapter is added.
Models are not downloaded by this update; required model files must already be installed or selected separately.

releases.title: Storyboard extras, GPT story planning, face-fix improvements, and quick engine switching

sections.title: New
items: Added mapped background extras with reference images, concise identity descriptions, group counts, scene mapping, and interaction roles such as background, background dancing, alongside, dancing with, and direct contact.
Added GPT Story planning handoff/import and Advanced Location Scout tools for packaging project lyrics, story context, references, mapped extras, locations, and visual presets as JSON.
Added shot-aware face-fix preparation plus opaque and landmark-aligned compositing options for more consistent face repairs across cuts and changing camera framing.
Added a clickable MiniMax/LTX project-engine badge in the top toolbar. Click it, or focus it and press Enter/Space, to switch engines without opening Settings.

sections.title: Improved
items: MiniMax prompt generation now supports mapped extras while preserving exact subject labels, reference limits, non-speaking extra behavior, and the existing prompt workflow.
Storyboard and Auto Build scene generation can continue past recoverable LLM failures and retry only skipped scenes instead of restarting the full batch.
MiniMax external prompts can be accepted without strict format validation by default; the 7,000-character hard limit remains enforced, and a testing switch restores strict validation.
Face-fix processing now handles LTX frame offsets and shot boundaries more reliably when preparing, aligning, and compositing repaired frames.

sections.title: Fixed
items: Fixed Export GPT Context in Ref Builder Scene Mapping so it copies the scene-mapping request and JSON before opening the GPT, with explicit inline JSON instructions that prevent the GPT from treating the pasted context as a missing attachment.
Fixed the top-toolbar LTX/MiniMax engine badge so it toggles from the main Builder scope without depending on the Settings modal being open or throwing a selector-scope error.

sections.title: Compatibility Notes
items: Restart ComfyUI and hard-refresh the browser after updating so the revised Python nodes and Builder JavaScript modules are loaded.
Existing projects remain on their selected video engine. The toolbar badge changes and autosaves the project-wide engine selection; it does not download models or alter model files.
The new face-fix alignment option requires the available OpenCV face-landmark detector asset and the corresponding face-fix workflow nodes.

releases.title: Video comparison recording, shot FX, and prompt workflow updates

sections.title: New
items: Added configurable Storyboard shot FX presets and custom FX JSON for lighting, lens, glitch, atmospheric, energy, film, distortion, supernatural, and music-video accents.
Added Video Compare Slider recording with configurable duration, browser capture, ComfyUI MP4 saving, and downloadable fallback recording support.
Added IMAGE-batch inputs to the Video Compare Slider so rendered image sequences can be previewed as browser-playable videos.

sections.title: Improved
items: Video Compare now provides clearer recording progress, media-load errors, labels, and output handling.
Video Builder side-panel prompt generation can use the shared Storyboard prompt pipeline and inject selected FX directly into timestamped shots.

sections.title: Fixed
items: Removed the hardcoded reference-subject-count block from generated prompts so prompts no longer receive that mandatory boilerplate.

sections.title: Compatibility Notes
items: Restart ComfyUI and hard-refresh the browser after updating so the revised Python and Builder JavaScript modules are loaded.
Video Compare recording and IMAGE-batch conversion require FFmpeg; the browser still offers a temporary WebM download if MP4 saving is unavailable.

releases.title: MiniMax framing, prompt reliability, and project workflow improvements

sections.title: New
items: Added context-aware intimate close-up framing selection tied to each scene's cut count, with persistent per-scene shot choices that avoid unnecessary repetition across scenes.
Added curated Music Video Shots and Fisheye and Distorted-Lens Shots camera-flow presets, each with its own context-aware candidate list and per-scene usage tracking.
Added project-scoped LLM API key save and load support, with an export warning when a project contains a saved API key.
Added an optional MiniMax H3 memory-efficient Sage Attention path with hardware and dependency validation.

sections.title: Improved
items: MiniMax prompt generation now preserves required cut wording, repairs common post-cut grammar issues, and adds explicit visible lip-sync guidance for sung lyrics and sustained non-verbal vocals.
Auto Build can pause after timeline creation so scenes can be reviewed before prompt creation, while lyric editing and storyboard context remain synchronized across Builder views.
Location descriptions can be expanded into detailed standalone environment descriptions for more consistent scene prompting.

The intimate close-up preset was the first preset-specific implementation of the candidate-list selection system; Music Video Shots and Fisheye and Distorted-Lens Shots now use the same per-preset curated-list logic, with additional presets planned later.

sections.title: Fixed
items: Fixed MiniMax framing injection so selected shot descriptions are written as natural prompt instructions instead of exposing internal builder terminology to the video model.
Fixed temporal/world-effect prompt assembly so the Builder owns the canonical continuity instruction without duplicating conflicting per-shot directions.
Added GPT-5.6 model choices to the Python and browser LLM runner configuration.

sections.title: Compatibility Notes
items: Restart ComfyUI and hard-refresh the browser after updating so the revised Python and Builder JavaScript modules are loaded.
The memory-efficient Sage Attention option requires a compatible SageAttention installation and supported CUDA architecture; standard attention remains available when it is disabled.

releases.title: Auto Build advanced controls and LM Studio compatibility

sections.title: New
items: Added collapsed Auto Build Advanced options for 8-second recommended coverage, 5-second lower-VRAM coverage, 6-second coverage, or a custom 1–60 second segment duration.
Added a GPT Scout location source that opens the existing Reference Builder location JSON importer and preserves imported location cards and scene mappings during Auto Build.

Added an option to preserve the project's current Scene Defaults, story layer, story arc, story beats, lyric story strength, and per-scene performance settings instead of applying Auto Build recommendations.

sections.title: Fixed
items: LM Studio native chat now retries once without the seed field when the server specifically rejects that unsupported key, while continuing to surface unrelated request and connection errors normally.

sections.title: Compatibility Notes
items: Restart ComfyUI and hard-refresh the browser after updating so the revised Builder JavaScript and Python modules are loaded.
Eight-second Auto Build segments remain the recommended default; five-second segments can reduce per-clip VRAM use.

releases.title: Auto Build and MiniMax singer cue workflow

sections.title: New
items: Added Auto Build to the Builder toolbar so music-video projects can create scenes, lyrics, references, mappings, defaults, and prompts from a simpler guided setup.
Added MiniMax Singer Assignment for split lyric cues, including timed lyric and instrumental rows, per-cue singer selection, and synchronized Reference Builder mappings.
Added compact per-cue audio playback controls so users can audition each lyric or instrumental slice while setting Start and End times.

Added timed Dialogue and Instrumental cue rows to MiniMax built-in-audio Speaker Assignment, bringing the same Start, End, Play Cue, custom-audio Auto Time This Scene, and boundary-sync workflow used by singer cues to generated dialogue scenes.
Added optional normal MiniMax H3 LoRA support with a LoRA count, chained LoRA dropdowns, per-LoRA strength controls, and a Kijai MiniMax H3 LoRA download link.
Added a shared MiniMax H3 prompt-generation path so the side panel, Storyboard Builder, Wizard Storyboard All, and Auto Build can produce the same final MiniMax prompt format.
Added Project Batch tooling for running saved projects one after another.

sections.title: Improved
items: MiniMax split lyric cues now drive shot count and cut timing, so prompt shots align with the assigned singer and cue boundaries.
MiniMax prompt generation now asks Gemma for creative shot JSON only while the Builder appends fixed reference, audio, continuity, and MiniMax format sections.

Storyboard Builder context is now passed into the same MiniMax H3 prompt context used by the side panel, keeping storyboard beats, camera guidance, style, temporal/world effects, facial direction, audio notes, and continuity aligned.
The Builder toolbar, shared tabs, buttons, and global font styling are more compact and easier to read in crowded MiniMax, LTX, and image-generation panels.
Changing a lyric cue to Instrumental now creates a new lyric slot underneath instead of merging or losing the lyric text.
Set End on one singer cue now automatically sets the next cue's Start time to the same boundary.
New split lyric cue maps now start with two larger lyric chunks instead of auto-splitting every couple of words, keeping Auto Build and manual review less crowded.
MiniMax normal LoRAs and MiniMax-H3 Turbo are now mutually exclusive, with Turbo controls disabled while the normal LoRA stack is active.

sections.title: Fixed
items: Fixed MiniMax multi-singer prompts so Audio 1 belongs to the target video instead of incorrectly assigning the whole song to Subject 1.
Fixed MiniMax prompt drift where side-panel generation, Storyboard Builder generation, and Auto Build could use slightly different request wrappers or instruction keys.
Fixed LTX-to-MiniMax conversion saving the intermediate JSON shot-description payload as the final MiniMax prompt instead of assembling the full MiniMax H3 prompt sections.
Fixed malformed LLM artifacts inside MiniMax dialogue tags and cleaned awkward post-cut wording such as 'the camera cuts to a medium close-up shows'.
Fixed blank Gemma shot descriptions by filling missing shots from the timed singer cue map instead of stopping prompt creation.
Fixed the top-right Builder close button so it asks whether to Save + Close, Close Without Saving, or Go Back before exiting.

sections.title: Compatibility Notes
items: Restart ComfyUI and hard-refresh the browser after updating so the new Builder JavaScript is loaded.
If a two-performer MiniMax shot swaps lip-sync unexpectedly, use tighter framing or over-the-shoulder composition for that cue while keeping the same singer assignment data.

releases.title: Storyboard Gemma reliability, Manager release, and updated guide

sections.title: Improved
items: Published the current AI Video Builder, MiniMax H3, Storyboard, and configurable render-wait feature set as ComfyUI Registry version 9.1.1 so ComfyUI Manager installs include the Builder launcher and recent updates.

Added a persistent Scene render wait limit in Builder Settings. Projects can keep individual and batch LTX or MiniMax scene waits active for 1–24 hours while existing projects retain the two-hour default.
Storyboard Gemma image and video prompt requests now allow up to ten minutes per scene, matching the Builder's established long-running Gemma prompt window.
Browser fetch failures now distinguish a real timeout from a lost ComfyUI backend connection and provide direct guidance for checking the queue, console, GPU layers, and context size.

Expanded the AI Video Builder guide with the recent MiniMax-H3 Turbo, scene-image inspiration, Face + hair priority, Cut frequency, LLM context/output, LTX-to-MiniMax conversion, silent playback, rendered-scene trim, and Delete ALL Videos workflows.

sections.title: Fixed
items: Fixed ComfyUI Manager continuing to install the July 3 version 9.0.0 package, which predated the Video Builder launcher, by advancing the registry package and runtime version through 9.1.1.

Fixed the MiniMax-H3 Turbo compatibility adapter rejecting extension v1.2.2 because upstream replaced its private _AdalnDelta wrapper with the safer _make_adaln_forward API; pruned Ref2VA models can now use Turbo with reference audio through either supported upstream API shape.
Fixed Storyboard Gemma All stopping on a slow first scene because its newer Video Builder path still used a four-minute request cutoff.
Fixed Firefox exposing the opaque 'NetworkError when attempting to fetch resource' message when a Storyboard prompt request timed out or the ComfyUI connection closed.

sections.title: Compatibility Notes
items: Manager-installed packages may not contain Git metadata, so update them through ComfyUI Manager rather than running git pull. Git commands and the Builder self-updater apply to installations created with git clone.
Restart ComfyUI and hard-refresh the browser after updating so both revised JavaScript modules are loaded.

A connection-lost message before the ten-minute limit usually means ComfyUI stopped or a local GGUF load exhausted memory; inspect the terminal and retry one scene with fewer GPU layers, a smaller context, or a smaller model.

releases.title: MiniMax Turbo, reference control, and larger LLM output

sections.title: New
items: Added optional MiniMax-H3 Turbo LoRA acceleration to MiniMax Video Settings. The hidden workflow injects the required Turbo LoRA and dedicated sampler, defaults to 4 editable steps, allows experimental step values below the usual 4-step target, automatically bypasses EasyCache, and restores the previous normal steps and EasyCache preference when Turbo is turned off.

Added a scope-aware MiniMax Reference-to-Video Scene image use dropdown. A scene image can be unused, supplied to both the LLM and MiniMax as the exact start frame, or supplied only to the vision LLM as environment inspiration with camera framing either ignored or optionally considered.

Added Face + hair only exact-start priority. Character references can replace only face identity and hair from the first generated frame while the start image remains authoritative for body, clothing, pose, composition, lighting, environment, and every other visible detail.

Added a MiniMax-only Cut frequency Scene Default from 0–10. Zero requests one continuous uninterrupted take, while 10 schedules one continuity-preserving CUT TO per second within each segment's exact duration.
Added separate persistent input-context and maximum-output controls for Gemma Local and LM Studio so longer MiniMax prompts are no longer constrained by the former small hardcoded task limits.

sections.title: Improved
items: Prompt-only scene-image inspiration is never sent to MiniMax, never receives an Image N label, and never consumes a renderer reference slot. Character references remain authoritative for character identity and appearance.

Builder, Storyboard, Wizard, Prompt Creator, and image-reference vision jobs now honor the selected local-runner output ceiling. LM Studio receives both context length and maximum output tokens through its native chat API.
Project-global MiniMax mode, model, video, scene-image, and character-priority changes now update every eligible unlocked scene while preserving independently locked scene settings.
The top status bar consistently uses the AI Video Builder product name and includes a persistent live badge showing whether the project is using LTX or MiniMax.
Existing projects saved with Turbo's old 20-step default migrate to 4 steps, and existing Turbo projects or locked scenes migrate to EasyCache bypass without overwriting later manual experimentation.

sections.title: Fixed
items: MiniMax-H3 Turbo now uses a packaged compatibility LoRA adapter for pruned models with reference audio, preventing the SamplerCustomAdvanced 3-versus-2 AdaLN tensor mismatch while automatically delegating to the upstream node once it includes the same fix.
The Video Wizard button opens again; Project Storage handlers no longer throw an out-of-scope JavaScript error during the Builder-to-Wizard handoff.
The MiniMax managed subject-count block respects Face + hair only start-frame priority and no longer grants character sheets conflicting authority over clothing or body proportions.
Runner progress labels correctly report LM Studio for selected-runner vision jobs, while genuinely local-only Gemma work remains labeled as built-in and honors the configured output limit.

Projects created from the PR #114 development branch migrate its legacy llm_max_tokens setting into the new Gemma and LM Studio limits; commercial LLM API requests continue ignoring local-runner limits.

sections.title: Compatibility Notes
items: MiniMax-H3 Turbo requires ComfyUI-MiniMax-H3-Turbo and the selected Turbo LoRA file. Standard MiniMax rendering remains unchanged when Turbo is disabled.

Existing LTX projects remain on the LTX engine unless MiniMax is explicitly selected. Prompt-only scene-image modes affect newly generated prompts, so regenerate an existing MiniMax prompt after changing that setting.

releases.title: Timeline editing and MiniMax prompt workflow improvements

sections.title: New
items: Added a one-button Tools-panel converter that sends every populated LTX video prompt through the selected LLM Runner and saves a separate, more detailed MiniMax H3 prompt without changing the original LTX prompt, global audio, scene timing, or other project data.
Added silent timeline playback so the playhead, scene selection, seeking, and scrubbing continue to work in short-film projects and other timelines that do not have global audio.
Added playhead trimming for rendered MiniMax built-in-audio and ID-LoRA scenes. Click or right-click the scissors button and choose whether to remove everything before or after the playhead.

Added Delete ALL Videos to clear every selected video, video history entry, thumbnail assignment, trim state, and rendered-video continuity assignment from the timeline while preserving the actual files in the project folder as backups.

sections.title: Improved
items: Rendered MiniMax H3 built-in-audio clips can now supply scene audio during timeline playback and begin from the rendered clip's local start when no global audio is present.

Renamed user-facing Music Video Builder and Video Creator labels to AI Video Builder across the main README, Builder guide, Prompt Creator, Storyboard Builder, Wizard, release notes, and package metadata.
Closing the Builder now stops global audio, scene audio, silent timeline playback, and active video-preview playback.

sections.title: Fixed
items: MiniMax Render All now displays and sends the complete saved right-panel prompt exactly as written instead of rewriting voice, B-roll, or continuity text during rendering.
Replaced an unbounded MiniMax managed-block cleanup pattern that could remove every timestamped shot, Audio section, and Continuity section after a visual-only B-roll block.
Timeline Play no longer stops with a Load audio first error when the project has no global audio; it automatically uses the silent timeline clock instead.
MiniMax built-in-audio timeline scrubbing now uses scene timeline time and the correct local media offset.

sections.title: Compatibility Notes
items: The LTX-to-MiniMax converter is for music-video projects and continues using the same unchanged global Audio 1 file; it does not enable MiniMax built-in audio.
Delete ALL Videos changes timeline assignments only. Existing rendered video and thumbnail files remain in the project folder and can still be used as backups.

releases.title: MiniMax H3 downloads and Story Arc reliability

sections.title: New
items: Reorganized Download Models into LTX + Image Models, LLM Models, and MiniMax H3 tabs while preserving every existing model link.
Added verified links and folder guidance for the MiniMax H3 diffusion model, Qwen3-VL text encoder, video VAE, and audio VAE.

sections.title: Fixed
items: Create User Story Arc now recognizes compound lyric headers such as [Intro] [Whispered] [Dark Atmosphere], ignores adjacent performance and mood tags plus [End], preserves consecutive real sections, and accepts harmless bracketed or first-occurrence-numbered Gemma headings.

releases.title: MiniMax H3 built-in audio and short-film authoring

sections.title: New
items: Added Built-in MiniMax Audio as an alternative to exact supplied Input Audio, with a dedicated hidden workflow that generates and preserves native scene audio through rendering and final stitching.
Added ordered per-scene speaker cues plus American, British, Australian, and custom voice descriptions saved with Reference Builder characters.

Added Guided Film Automation, Fully Custom short-film scene cards, and a Script Mapper that validates speaker: dialogue text or JSON, maps speakers to saved characters, preserves exact cue order and wording, previews timing, and creates the real timeline only after review.
Added previous-scene spatial-reference and exact-start-frame continuity modes while preserving MiniMax's nine-image reference limit.
Added MiniMax video-aesthetic controls and protected-character temporal/world effects for Storyboard planning.
Added an optional custom projects root for newly created projects without moving existing projects or ComfyUI temporary render output.

sections.title: Improved
items: MiniMax prompts now keep Input Audio and Built-in Audio contracts separate, preserve exact speaker order, avoid repeating full dialogue or lyrics in every timestamp, and relax visible mouths after the audible vocal ends.
MiniMax render progress can display the exact prompt, lyric or dialogue, mode, and ordered reference images being sent for the current scene.
The per-scene render wait limit was increased from 40 minutes to two hours.
Multi-view character sheets are now treated as one subject instead of creating duplicate people from alternate views.

sections.title: Fixed
items: MiniMax H3 scenes marked B-roll or no-lip-sync now suppress singer, lyric, speaker, and native-voice inputs, remove conflicting vocal actions from timestamp blocks, and receive a final visual-only safety contract again at render time.
Cyrillic and other Unicode letters are preserved during reference-lyric timestamp matching instead of being stripped by ASCII-only normalization.
Added a session-save safeguard that prevents an ordinary stale save from accidentally clearing many populated lyric lines at once.

sections.title: Compatibility Notes
items: Existing and newly created projects continue to use LTX 2.3 unless MiniMax H3 is explicitly selected in Builder Settings.
MiniMax Input Audio remains the exact supplied soundtrack path; Built-in MiniMax Audio must be selected when generated voices, dialogue, ambience, or sound effects are required.

releases.title: MiniMax H3 Video Builder testing support

sections.title: New
items: Added MiniMax H3 as a project video engine while keeping existing and newly loaded LTX projects on the unchanged LTX path by default.

Added project-global Text to Video, Image to Video, Reference to Video, and Video to Video modes with dedicated MiniMax model, resolution, timing, sampler, EasyCache, Sage Attention, and FP16 settings.

Added a per-scene lock in MiniMax Video Settings that copies and preserves the current mode, models, render settings, and advanced settings for that scene while unlocked scenes continue following the project-global values.

Added ordered Reference Builder images, optional exact scene-image start frames, and reference-video inputs for MiniMax character, location, continuation, motion, camera, transformation, and visual-editing workflows.
Added MiniMax-specific LLM instructions and Storyboard prompting with exact scene timing, ordered Image and Video assignments, Audio 1 usage, lyric text, and lip-sync guidance.
Added exact MiniMax frame planning and custom-audio preparation so rendered scenes cover the selected timeline range and are trimmed back to its exact duration.

Added MiniMax Render All support for rendering missing clips or creating new versions from Storyboard prompts, using each scene's effective global or locked mode and settings before stitching the completed project.

Added a Builder Settings checkbox for automatic RAM/VRAM cleanup. When disabled, embedded cleanup nodes and automatic post-task cache clearing are bypassed while the manual Clear Memory button remains available.

sections.title: Fixed
items: Storyboard All, Reference Builder, LLM prompting, validation, and rendering now consistently use each scene's effective global or locked MiniMax mode instead of letting untouched scenes silently fall back to Text to Video.
Render All now routes MiniMax projects through the MiniMax hidden workflow instead of the LTX renderer and ignores stale LTX-only mode, post-processing, canvas, and embedded-audio behavior.

sections.title: Testing Notes
items: This first MiniMax H3 Builder workflow requires project audio or custom scene audio and currently uses non-GGUF diffusion models.
Built-in MiniMax audio, GGUF loading, and MiniMax post-processing workflows are not part of this initial testing build.

releases.title: Reference lyric transcription and Story Arc reliability

sections.title: Improved
items: Transcribe Existing Scenes now uses the supplied reference lyrics as the exact lyric source while acoustic transcription determines where each word belongs.
Beat mode now creates its beat-aligned segments first and automatically runs the same reference-preserving Transcribe Existing Scenes process with Replace All.

sections.title: Fixed
items: Prevented Transcribe Existing Scenes from silently omitting reference lyric lines or inserting pipe delimiters between lyrics.
Improved sustained boundary-word placement so audible final words follow their detected vocal tail into the correct scene instead of leaving that scene marked instrumental.
Prevented unrecognized first or last words from being stretched across several seconds of inter-line silence and assigned to the wrong scene.
Story Arc Gemma now removes only invented trailing sections after every required lyric heading is already present, while continuing to reject missing, renamed, reordered, or interleaved headings.

releases.title: Faster scene selection and Ingredients panel fix

sections.title: New
items: Select Multi now opens a chooser for selecting clips directly on the timeline or entering base scene numbers as a list.
Scene lists accept commas, spaces, new lines, ranges such as 4-8, pasted lists, and all, odd, or even shortcuts.
Entered scene lists can replace the current selection, add scenes to it, or remove scenes from it.

sections.title: Improved
items: Multi-select now shows live scene-list validation, clearer instructions, and preserves an existing selection when the mode is reopened.

sections.title: Fixed
items: Fixed the Ingredients Reference Builder tab container so the Sheets, Mapping, and Locations panels mount and display correctly.

releases.title: Timeline controls and smarter Storyboard prompts

sections.title: New
items: Added persistent Render All logs with live timing, per-scene phase details, ETA summaries, final-stitch timing, and saved JSON and text reports.
Added an inline Motion Notes column to Storyboard Video Prep using the same notes stored in each Scene Card and sent to prompt generation.
Gemma Video All now opens an in-app choice to create only missing prompts or redo every visible scene, with exact missing and completed counts.

sections.title: Improved
items: Add Segment now uses the scrubber as the new endpoint when it is at least 0.5 seconds beyond the last clip, snaps that endpoint to the nearest beat when beat snapping is enabled, and confirms unusually long segments.
Added Space for play or pause and S for Add Segment, and made the Storyboard prompt status and scene actions more compact.
Missing-only Storyboard prompt generation preserves completed prompts and saves successful partial progress if a later scene fails.

sections.title: Fixed
items: Fixed Left and Right Arrow scene navigation so it continues working after scene-list re-renders while remaining inactive during text entry and dialogs.
Custom Storyboard Motion Notes now override the scene-default camera-motion preset in Gemma requests, preventing conflicting directions such as a push-in combined with track left.

releases.title: Standalone video enhancer with 2K–4K output

sections.title: New
items: Added VRGDG Standalone Video Enhancer, a clean interface outside Video Builder for uploading an existing video, previewing effects, rendering, and saving the finished result.
Added Original, 2K, 3K, and 4K output choices using high-quality Lanczos resizing while preserving aspect ratio and portrait or landscape orientation.
Added Fast Unsharp Sharpen controls up to strength 10 and Fast Film Grain controls with intensity, saturation mix, and deterministic seed settings.

sections.title: Improved
items: Added current-frame and synchronized final-video before-and-after comparison with a draggable wipe slider and screen-filling expanded view.
Long videos render in memory-aware frame batches with checkpoint resume, cancellation, automatic GPU out-of-memory retry, and optional preservation of the original audio.

releases.title: Video comparison, global audio, and Builder performance

sections.title: New
items: Added VRGDG Video Compare Slider with synchronized before-and-after playback, a draggable comparison divider, timeline scrubbing, looping, labels, and optional audio.
Added a visual Storyboard subject picker for assigning one or more existing Reference Builder subjects to a scene or uploading a new subject.

sections.title: Improved
items: Increased Fast Unsharp Sharpen strength from a maximum of 2.0 to 10.0.
Improved Video Builder undo memory by deduplicating embedded media and recording inspector text edits once per edit session.
Added stable, versioned thumbnail URLs and immutable caching so scene thumbnails are not downloaded again on every render.
Storyboard imports now merge incoming subjects and locations with existing references instead of ignoring new references when mappings already exist.

sections.title: Fixed
items: Global audio now remains the preferred final soundtrack and fills scenes without custom audio during scene-audio preparation and stitching.
Loading or restoring global audio now correctly restores timeline playback and the visible waveform instead of remaining on silent scene audio.
The Video Builder menu now stays inside the viewport and scrolls so every menu action remains accessible.

releases.title: Lyric timing, Storyboard prompts, and scene merging

sections.title: New
items: Added right-click actions to merge a scene with its left or right neighbor while combining lyrics, notes, singers, and scene mappings without shifting surrounding scene timing.
Added a confirmation warning before transcription when reference lyrics contain parenthesized text that will be treated as sung or spoken lyrics.

sections.title: Improved
items: Wizard lyric scene creation now uses the same shared Create Scenes From Lines engine as Line Mapping.
Pasted lyric lines and stanzas remain intact even when their detected duration falls outside the minimum or maximum scene settings.
Exact reference-line mode keeps normal lyric alignment, instrumental-gap detection, vocal-tail padding, and boundary cleanup while ignoring only minimum and maximum duration limits.
Only [instrumental] and [instrumental break] force no-vocal sections; [intro], [outro], and [break] remain section headers because those sections may contain lyrics.
Wizard lyric output removes parenthesis characters after transcription while preserving the lyric words inside them.

sections.title: Fixed
items: Manual video prompts now render exactly as entered: typing, pasting, Prompt Options edits, reloads, and find/replace remain manual even after a later Gemma edit, while automatic trigger, vocal, facial-performance, and ID-LoRA prompt augmentation is limited to prompts originally created by Gemma.
Prevented final render preparation from appending the facial-performance direction a second time after it was already included in the generated video prompt.

Storyboard Video Prep now explicitly begins non-I2V prompts with the selected starting shot, including an extreme close-up for an eyes shot, and preserves that opening through the embedded Video Builder prompt path without changing ordinary I2V first-frame behavior.
Prevented stale inspector values from overwriting a different scene and creating blank, truncated, or 0.1-second scenes.
Improved unmatched reference-line timing so unaligned lyrics receive natural text-sized timing instead of stretching across large portions of the song.
Improved vocal-tail and shared-boundary cleanup to prevent lyric scenes from overlapping or being pushed away from their detected word starts.

releases.title: Builder navigation, update details, and reliability fixes

sections.title: New
items: Added Review Guide to the Builder menu for direct access to the public AI Video Builder guide.
Added a clear legacy notice before opening the older Prompt Creator workflow.
Added an optional What's New window so users can review release details from the status banner or Builder menu.

sections.title: Improved
items: New projects now open directly in Video Builder.
Prompt Creator is labeled as a legacy workflow, with Storyboard Builder recommended for new story planning.

sections.title: Fixed
items: Removed the obsolete Remake Mode menu item.
Fixed the update-status banner so it no longer stretches the toolbar or reduces the main workspace.
Fixed update detection for development builds whose changes were squash-merged to main.
Fixed ID-LoRA GGUF rendering so the unused safetensors loader is removed before ComfyUI validates the prompt.

releases.title: Expanded Storyboard and Browser AI guide

sections.title: Documentation
items: Added Storyboard Builder screenshots for the main window, Story Layer, Image Prep defaults, and Video Prep defaults.
Added Browser AI screenshots for provider setup, manual mode, and Band Sequence groups.
